description: `multiverse worktrees <path>` reads `.multiverse/worktrees/` straight off disk (`worktrees.lanes`: a directory whose name validates as a task id enters lane discovery — no `git worktree` registration required, per that function's own docstring: 'a lane whose git registration was lost still shows up'). Seeded here with an OLD pre-rename dispatch role name (`fixer`) in the task id and routing.log, exactly like this repo's other `history-*` scenarios, alongside one foreign (non-task-id) entry under the same worktrees root that `_report_ignored_lane_entries` must name as 'ignored: not a lane' rather than folding into the lane listing. `--prune --dry-run` previews rather than mutates (per conformance/README.md's own worktrees guidance: predict, never run the destructive form in a scenario) and is used here specifically so the live lane's own 'kept' reasoning prints: the lane's one occupant (`lane_occupants` always includes the lane directory's own name) has no terminal status anywhere (`lane_outcome` reads both the project's and the lane's own `.multiverse/tasks/<id>/status`; neither exists here) and its dispatch's recorded pane (`routing.log`'s `event=started ... pane=w1:p1`) is still live per the scripted `agent list` reply, so `live_unsettled_occupant` refuses to treat it as safe to remove.
